tagline: Self-hosted SEO tool for keyword research, rank tracking and audits, powered by your own DataForSEO key.
description: OpenSEO is an SEO workbench covering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits and AI visibility tracking. It does not own a data index. Every number comes from DataForSEO, a pay-as-you-go service for which you supply an API key and pay directly. New DataForSEO accounts get $1 of credit, and the minimum top-up is $50. You can self-host in two ways. The Docker route is meant for personal use on one machine and starts with app authentication turned off. The Cloudflare route deploys with a single command to your account, works on the free plan, and puts a Cloudflare Access login in front. OpenSEO also exposes an MCP server and agent skills so tools like Claude Code can query your SEO data. The licence is MIT. A hosted version costs $10 per month. It replaces Semrush or Ahrefs for lighter jobs, with metered costs instead of a subscription.
strengths: No subscription: you pay DataForSEO per request
Covers keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits and AI visibility
MCP server and agent skills for Claude Code and similar agents
Cloudflare deployment provisions the database, storage and an Access login in one command
limits: Needs a DataForSEO account; the minimum top-up is $50
The Docker setup runs with authentication disabled, so it must sit behind your own proxy login or a private network
The Cloudflare route requires R2, which needs a payment method on file even in the free tier
The app sends anonymised usage telemetry, such as aggregate counts, tied to a random install ID
Its data comes from one third-party API, so coverage and freshness are those of DataForSEO
bestFor: A freelance SEO or small agency with occasional research needs that finds Semrush and Ahrefs subscriptions too heavy.
